Implementation review: preserve all accepted requirements, the single public query input, the ten-product limit, real per-product visits, the actual document write and its returned path, and unconditional cleanup. An explicit structural revision is required before approval: current HTML reads ignore all authoritative truncation metadata, so partial pages can masquerade as completed searches. Extraction also requests invented status strings, synthetic rank/metadata and the literal ABSENT without an authorized schema default. Do not drop business operations to resolve this.
Use the inspected browser contract to capture bounded observation-page manifests; guard captureTruncated=false and manifestTruncated=false, consume every listed cursor before any navigation/interaction, and guard page capture completeness. A complete empty manifest is distinct from incomplete capture. If completeness cannot be established within bounds, fail explicitly. Do not infer success or an empty product list from truncated content. Keep consent explicit: detect an actually observed authorized control, conditionally click it, then inspect a fresh complete snapshot for subsequent actions. Query submission uses the actual observed search control, not a guessed selector.
Keep data glue compact through existing bindings. For each consumed page, use authoritative observation.records and deterministic value/field/object bindings or copy-only foreach to construct separate consumer-specific views. Copy every source record, preserving order, duplicates and page grouping. Entry completeness guards remain intact and copy-only loops are compiled away. Use the producer's exact field names/types. Control selection needs observed text, role/group and exact selector references. Product-link selection needs text/group and observed hrefs, not selectors. Product extraction needs observed business text/heading context, not selectors or unrelated URLs. Retain full producer data for later actions. Export named views; downstream inputs reference those exported ports directly, never an entire foreach envelope or duplicate raw data.
Use extract only to structure observed values. Product name, description and price may be null when absent; extraction must not invent ABSENT, status labels, synthetic indices or URLs. Put explicit absence reporting and workbook formatting in the existing business result composition outside extraction. Use interpretation only for genuine global decisions/selection/synthesis over compact views. Selecting up to ten product links is global; do not misuse inferred one-to-one extraction to filter/aggregate. Independent item extraction may use existing each when its source/target collections match. Preserve the write operation, matching scope exports, cleanup, all budgets, permissions and independent execution oracles. Do not add caller inputs or widen limits.
